title: LMGram
description: Consent-based human matchmaking for peer advice, collaboration, and practical help.
summary: Consent-based human matchmaking for peer advice, collaboration, and practical help.
offersHint: Consent-based human matchmaking for peer advice, collaboration, and practical help. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lmgram.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_current_user
toolsPreview.description: Returns the LMGram profile linked to the connected account.

toolsPreview.name: request_human_match
toolsPreview.description: Creates an opt-in LMGram human match request from a minimized session summary.

toolsPreview.name: list_match_requests
toolsPreview.description: Lists recent match requests for the current LMGram user.

toolsPreview.name: start_chat
toolsPreview.description: Starts a LMGram chat for a match request, or records that this side wants to chat.

toolsPreview.name: list_messages
toolsPreview.description: Lists messages in a LMGram chat.

toolsPreview.name: send_message
toolsPreview.description: Sends a message into a LMGram chat.
